name: Daniel
description: Prophet living at the time of Exile and Return

points: Though these three men, Noah, Daniel, and Job, were in it, they should deliver but their own souls by their righteousness. That's what Noah did, his wife did, his sons did, and their wives did: saved themselves by their own righteousness. Likewise Daniel, likewise Job.

note.label: As in the Days of Noah: Past & Present

points: Though these three men, Noah, Daniel, and Job, were in it, they should deliver but their own souls by their righteousness.

note.label: Ezekiel 14: Idols in the Heart and the Four Sore Judgments

points: Behold, thou art wiser than Daniel. So the white man is wiser than Daniel, through his technology. Right now he watching us. Watch at this: you could see me. Some of you all is in another country and you could see me right now, I'm talking to you, I'm pointing, you could see everything I'm doing. That's witchcraft, man. That's witchcraft. Back in the days this would be called magic. Magic. Today you call it technology, but this is magic. I'm speaking in this and everybody could hear me. People all over the world could hear me. I'm speaking into this mic. It's witchcraft. When Christ return, all of this technology will go. It have to go. It's all witchcraft. The white man invented it.

note.label: Economic Collapse & Uncertain Riches

points: Behold, thou art wiser than Daniel; there is no secret that they can hide from thee. There is no secret you can hide from the white man. Everything you type on these devices is recorded; nothing disappears.

note.label: They Say We Hate White People

points: Behold, thou art wiser than Daniel; there is no secret that they can hide from thee: with wisdom and understanding they got riches, gold and silver into their treasures. Look at the Native American treaties the United States made and broke, like the Treaty of Fort Laramie of 1868, violated the minute gold was discovered. They know geology; they know where the gold is, and that is why the forts sit where they sit. By thy great wisdom and by thy traffick hast thou increased thy riches: by the way they traded slaves is how they became who they are today.

note.label: Edom: The Greatly Despised

points: Behold, thou art wiser than Daniel; there is no secret that they can hide from thee. Daniel could tell a king his dream; this man can talk face to face across the world on a device and knows every skeleton in your closet.

note.label: Cyber Warfare: The Mouth Of The Beast

points: Among those taken were of the children of Judah: Daniel, Hananiah, Mishael, and Azariah.

note.label: Daniel 1: The Best of Israel Carried to Babylon

points: The prince of the eunuchs gave them new names, Belteshazzar, Shadrach, Meshach, and Abednego, part of assimilating them into the king's service.

note.label: Daniel 1: The Best of Israel Carried to Babylon

points: And the decree went forth that the wise men should be slain; and they sought Daniel and his fellows to be slain.

note.label: When God Reveals His Secrets!

points: Then Daniel answered with counsel and wisdom to Arioch the captain of the king's guard, which was gone forth to slay the wise men of Babylon: he answered and said to Arioch the king's captain, Why is the decree so hasty from the king? Then Arioch made the thing known to Daniel. So Daniel was like, slow down. What are you going to kill everybody for? Let me go talk to God. Why are you so hasty to kill everybody?

note.label: When God Reveals His Secrets!

points: So the king's wise men, they couldn't figure out the writing on the wall. I mean the dream, I'm sorry. They didn't know the dream that he had, and they needed an interpretation. They said nobody can interpret, because the king wouldn't tell him what the dream was, because the king didn't remember what the dream was. Then he said, well, let's ask Daniel. Daniel said, give me a second, about to give you this understanding. I like this one. Read. Read on.

note.label: From Milk to Meat: Train All Your Senses

points: Then Daniel went in, and desired of the king that he would give him time, and that he would shew the king the interpretation.

note.label: When God Reveals His Secrets!

points: Then Daniel went to his house, and made the thing known to Hananiah, Mishael, and Azariah, his companions. His partners. That they would desire mercies of the God of heaven concerning this secret. We need to figure out what is going on. So he told his boys, let us ask God to reveal this to us.

note.label: When God Reveals His Secrets!

points: That Daniel and his fellows should not perish with the rest of the wise men of Babylon. Then was the secret revealed unto Daniel in a night vision. Then Daniel blessed the God of heaven.

note.label: When God Reveals His Secrets!

points: Right? Remember God said in Numbers 12, he says, I will visit you in a vision and in a dream. So now, suddenly Daniel understood what this whole thing was about. Why? God had imparted upon him. Read.

note.label: From Milk to Meat: Train All Your Senses

points: Then the king Nebuchadnezzar fell upon his face, and worshipped Daniel, and commanded that they should offer an oblation and sweet odours unto him. The king answered unto Daniel, and said, Of a truth it is, that your God is a God of gods, and a Lord of kings, and a revealer of secrets. Of what? Of secrets.

note.label: When God Reveals His Secrets!

points: But Daniel sat in the gate of the king. So it is good when the Lord reveals secrets to you, especially when you could interpret a dream, because a lot of people have dreams. Imagine the dream was so bad with the king, he said, I am killing everybody if you cannot explain this dream to me. And a lot of times we have dreams and they mess us up.

note.label: When God Reveals His Secrets!

points: Then the king made Daniel a great man, and gave him many great gifts, and made him ruler over the whole province of Babylon, and chief of the governors over all the wise men of Babylon. Then Daniel requested of the king, and he set Shadrach, Meshach, and Abednego, over the affairs of the province of Babylon. So because he was able to reveal those secrets and explain the dream, he set his boys up, because the king was ready to give him whatever he wanted. So he said, I want you to hook my men up.

note.label: When God Reveals His Secrets!

points: The magicians, astrologers, Chaldeans, and soothsayers could not make known the interpretation, but at last Daniel came in, named Belteshazzar after the king's god, in whom is the spirit of the holy gods.
Daniel was named after one of the king's gods. It is the same thing as Hadassah, whose name was changed to Esther; this is not new for us.

note.label: Daniel 4: Nebuchadnezzar Abased Until He Knew the Most High Rules

points: Daniel, astonished for an hour, told the king the dream was for his enemies: the tree is the king himself, grown strong to the ends of the earth.

note.label: Daniel 4: Nebuchadnezzar Abased Until He Knew the Most High Rules

points: Belshazzar clothed Daniel with scarlet, put a chain about his neck, and proclaimed him third ruler, but that same night Belshazzar the king of the Chaldeans was slain and Darius the Median took the kingdom, being about threescore and two years old.

note.label: Daniel 5: The Handwriting on the Wall

points: It pleased Darius to set a hundred and twenty princes over the kingdom, with three presidents over them, of whom Daniel was first, so the king should have no damage.

note.label: Daniel 6: Daniel in the Den of Lions

points: Daniel was preferred above the presidents and princes because an excellent spirit was in him, and the king thought to set him over the whole realm. He was set in a very high position in government.

note.label: Daniel 6: Daniel in the Den of Lions

points: The presidents and princes sought to find occasion against Daniel, but there was no error or fault found in him. This man lived up to a name integrity, even when they tried to force them to worship other gods, and the Lord showed favor to Daniel.

note.label: Character & Integrity: The Hidden Strength Behind Wisdom

points: The presidents and princes sought occasion against Daniel concerning the kingdom but could find none, because he was faithful and no error or fault was found in him. He was blameless.

note.label: Daniel 6: Daniel in the Den of Lions

points: When Daniel knew the writing was signed he went home, and with his windows open toward Jerusalem kneeled and prayed three times a day, giving thanks as he did before.

note.label: Daniel 6: Daniel in the Den of Lions

points: The men assembled, found him praying, and reported to the king that Daniel, of the children of the captivity of Judah, regarded neither the king nor the decree but made his petition three times a day. They really hated Daniel and knew the only way to find fault was concerning the law of his God.

note.label: Daniel 6: Daniel in the Den of Lions

points: The king was displeased with himself and laboured till sundown to deliver Daniel, but the men pressed that the law could not be changed, so he commanded Daniel cast into the den, saying, thy God whom thou servest continually, he will deliver thee.

note.label: Daniel 6: Daniel in the Den of Lions

points: He rose very early and went in haste to the den, crying with a lamentable voice, O Daniel, servant of the living God, is thy God able to deliver thee from the lions.

note.label: Daniel 6: Daniel in the Den of Lions

points: The king was glad and commanded Daniel taken up, and no manner of hurt was found on him because he believed in his God; then the accusers, their children, and wives were cast in and the lions brake their bones before they reached the bottom.

note.label: Daniel 6: Daniel in the Den of Lions

points: Darius wrote to all people, nations, and languages that in every dominion men tremble and fear before the God of Daniel, for he is the living God, stedfast for ever, whose kingdom shall not be destroyed and who delivereth and rescueth and worketh signs and wonders.

note.label: Daniel 6: Daniel in the Den of Lions

points: So Daniel prospered in the reign of Darius and of Cyrus the Persian. He had a wise and humble spirit, was beloved by the king, could answer visions and interpret dreams, and was of the king's seed as shown in chapter one.

note.label: Daniel 6: Daniel in the Den of Lions

points: In the first year of Belshazzar king of Babylon, Daniel had a dream and visions of his head upon his bed, and he wrote the dream and told the sum of the matters.
This dream is the same subject Daniel returns to in chapter 8 and again in the later chapters. He tells the vision more than once.

note.label: Daniel 7: The Four Beasts

points: I Daniel was grieved in my spirit, and the visions of my head troubled me: because the Lord was showing Daniel visions about the end time, just like he did with the apostle John in the book of Revelation. John wanted to know about the mystery of that eighth head which came from the seventh; Daniel is saying the same thing.

note.label: Making the Great Red Dragon's 8th Head 'great Again'

points: Daniel kept the matter in his heart, his cogitations much troubling him and his countenance changed.

note.label: Daniel 7: The Four Beasts

points: In the third year of Belshazzar's reign, a vision appeared to Daniel after the first, and he saw himself at Shushan in the palace in the province of Elam, by the river of Ulai.

note.label: Daniel 8: The Ram and the Goat

points: As Daniel sought the meaning, one with the appearance of a man stood before him, and a voice called Gabriel to make him understand the vision.

note.label: Daniel 8: The Ram and the Goat

points: Daniel fainted and was sick certain days, then rose and did the king's business, astonished at the vision, but none understood it. The Most High gives his prophets to understand dark sayings and visions.

note.label: Daniel 8: The Ram and the Goat

points: I Daniel understood by books: what books? The scriptures, the prophecies in the holy Bible. He matched the current events of his time period with the prophecies written in the holy Bible, and he said, wow, I'm in the time that Jeremiah spoke of in Jeremiah chapter 29; this is that time period right now. But if you're not watching and praying, how can you line up what's going on today with the scriptures and know how to move, know how to move in wisdom?

note.label: Perilous Times: Judges and Soldiers

points: Daniel understood by books. If the books do not coincide with what the scriptures say, do not follow them.

note.label: Puerto Rico: The Flame Of Resistance

points: In the third year of Cyrus king of Persia, a thing was revealed unto Daniel, whose name was called Belteshazzar, and the thing was true but the time appointed was long, and he understood the vision.

note.label: Daniel 10: A Man Clothed in Linen

points: Daniel alone saw the vision; the men with him did not see it but a great quaking fell on them and they fled. Daniel was left alone, his strength turned to corruption, and he fell into a deep sleep on his face toward the ground.

note.label: Daniel 10: A Man Clothed in Linen

points: A hand touched Daniel and set him upon his knees and palms, and he was told he is a man greatly beloved, to understand the words spoken and stand upright, for he was now sent to him.

note.label: Daniel 10: A Man Clothed in Linen

points: The one speaking told Daniel that from the first day he set his heart to understand and to chasten himself before the Most High, his words were heard, and he came for his words. The Most High heard Daniel's supplications and prayer because he was beloved, and gave him these visions for the same reason. It is the same with Israel, the beloved of the Most High.

note.label: Daniel 10: A Man Clothed in Linen

points: Daniel is told to shut up the words and seal the book even to the time of the end, and many shall run to and fro, and knowledge shall be increased.

note.label: Daniel 12: The Time of the End

points: Daniel heard but understood not, and asked what shall be the end of these things. Go thy way, Daniel, for the words are closed up and sealed till the time of the end. We are living in the time of the end, so it is not sealed anymore. Many shall be purified and made white and tried; the brothers who stand strong through Jacob's trouble get the kingdom and the immortal body.

note.label: The Real Reason Iran Was Attacked

points: Daniel hears but understands not, and asks what shall be the end of these things, and he is told to go his way, for the words are closed up and sealed till the time of the end, which is now being opened.

In the Greeks' time it was the Greeks, in Christ's time the Romans, and today the Europeans from Germany, Poland, Russia, and Ukraine who went into the holy land in 1949 in the name of Christ saying we are the people of God. They are called desolation because they destroy everything; ask the Palestinians about the Nakba. Then shall be great tribulation such as was not since the beginning of the world: it is twofold, Rome's destruction of Jerusalem and the third woe, and the abomination of desolation instigates it.

points: The abomination of desolation spoken of by Daniel the prophet standing in the holy place. That has a fulfilment already in history, when swine's flesh was offered in the temple.

cases.name: Daniel
cases.charge: Purposing in his heart not to defile himself with the portion of the king’s meat nor with the wine which he drank; kneeling and praying three times a day with his windows open toward Jerusalem, as he did aforetime, after the decree was signed
cases.preview: Daniel, of the king’s seed of Judah, was carried to Babylon with the best of Israel’s youth to be trained for the king’s service, and he resolved not to defile himself with the king’s meat and wine;

cases.name: Daniel’s accusers
cases.charge: Seeking occasion against Daniel and finding none; procuring a decree by the law of the Medes and Persians that no man petition any god or man for thirty days save the king, to take him in the law of his God; assembling to find him praying and pressing the king to cast him to the lions
